newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce says Dragonair in $100 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce says Dragonair in $100 mln order.

text.p: Rolls-Royce said it is to share in a $100 million order for V2500 engines from Dragonair for up to seven Airbus Industrie A320 regional jet airliners.
Rolls-Royce's share in the deal is valued at more than $30 million.
Rolls-Royce is a major shareholder in the International Aero Engines consortium that makes the V2500.
The Hong-Kong based airline plans to purchase two A320s, each with a capacity of 168 passengers, and take options on five more, adding to seven A320s already in service.

Dragonair will also lease one more Rolls-Royce Trent 700 powered A330-300 wide body twinjet from International Lease Finance Corporation, taking the total number of wide-body aircraft in its fleet to five by mid-1997.
